overview: The Community Development Board held a public hearing on the Community Development Block Grant (CDBG) Consolidated Annual Performance Evaluation Report (CAPER) for the program year ending June 30, 2026. Planning Director Alicia Hunt presented past program expenditures, highlighted community achievements, and outlined upcoming development initiatives.

items.title: Introduction to the CDBG CAPER Hearing
items.summary: Director Alicia Hunt opened the public hearing to present the city's annual performance report for CDBG funds used between July 1, 2025, and June 30, 2026.

items.title: Review of Fiscal Year Accomplishments and Expenditures
items.summary: Hunt detailed the expenditure of over $1 million in funding, highlighting completed projects including Arlington Street sidewalk installations, housing rehabilitation loans, public services support, and vacant storefront grants.

items.title: Upcoming Program Year Plans
items.summary: Hunt previewed upcoming initiatives, such as additional housing rehab loans, playground design at Tufts Park, and the establishment of a Neighborhood Revitalization Strategy Area to better serve low-to-moderate-income communities.

items.title: Public Comment and Adjournment
items.summary: Hunt opened the floor for public feedback, noting that written comments on the CAPER report are accepted through September 27, 2026, before adjourning the meeting due to no public comments being submitted during the call.

subject: CDBG Consolidated Annual Performance Evaluation Report
